role: Language layer type constants for the Co-Being Procedural Knowledge Graph
detail: Defines node type and edge type string constants used by language bootstrap, syntactic template matcher, morphological procedure engine, and organic language acquisition pipeline. Node types: WordSenseNode (SCHEMA, polysemy-aware word senses), WordFormNode (INSTANCE, inflected surface forms), ConversationTurnNode (INSTANCE, utterances in context), InterpretationNode (INSTANCE, competing parse candidates), WordNode (INSTANCE, deduplicated normalized word tokens from guardian speech), PhraseNode (INSTANCE, opaque holophrase chunks with encoding strength computed via arousal * novelty * anxiety_penalty). Edge types encode relationships between these nodes and to the procedural/concept layer. OLA edges (CANON A.26.3): CAN_PRODUCE (schema-level, gate requires encounter_count >= 3), HEARD_DURING (instance-level, captures drive_snapshot and prediction_error at encoding), IS_PART_OF (WordNode -> PhraseNode with position tracking), SUPERSEDES (within-episode phrase correction), VARIANT_OF (phrases >60% word overlap clustered). Synaptogenesis edges (LLM-proposed, entry confidence 0.15): FOLLOWS_PATTERN, USED_DURING, RELATED_TO. Phase 1.7 Language Foundation (CANON A.18) and Phase 2 OLA (CANON A.26).
gotchas: IDENTIFIES_WITH marked deferred implementation (decision 2026-03-08) - exists only in schema, not yet created by consolidation. PhraseNode.raw_texts and HEARD_DURING.drive_snapshot are JSON-serialized in graph. WORD_NODE deduplication is by normalized form only - same word across multiple phrases is single node with multiple IS_PART_OF edges. IS_PART_OF direction rationale: word->phrase, not phrase->word, to enable distributional semantics queries. Rehearsal credits accumulate at 0.5x internal rehearsal rate. No NLP required per CANON A.26.
